summary: Frontend-only verification of cart drawer bug fix on 123Bots storefront. Confirmed that the header cart-button (data-testid='cart-button') now correctly opens the CartDrawer via CartContext, add-to-cart increments the badge, and Proceed to Checkout navigates to /checkout while closing the drawer.

issues: Radix DialogContent warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' — a11y/console warning; add SheetDescription or aria-describedby to SheetContent.

action_items: Optional: add a SheetDescription (or aria-describedby) inside CartDrawer's SheetContent to remove the Radix a11y warning.
Consider linking /shop/products product cards' 'Add to Cart' directly from the listing card to avoid needing to open the PDP (UX minor).
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx correctly uses setIsCartOpen from useCart() and renders <CartDrawer /> with no props — fix aligns with CartContext contract.
CartDrawer.jsx correctly reads isCartOpen/setIsCartOpen from context and controls Sheet with open={isCartOpen} onOpenChange={setIsCartOpen}.
Product detail page path is /shop/{category}/{slug} (e.g. /shop/cc1-pro/pudu-cc1-pro); the marketing routes /products/{slug} do NOT expose an Add to Cart button — expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified end-to-end: /shop/products -> click product -> PDP at /shop/cc1-pro/pudu-cc1-pro -> ADD TO CART -> header cart-button opens drawer showing 'Your Cart (1 items)' with PUDU CC1 PRO -> Proceed to Checkout navigates to /checkout and closes drawer. Cart badge shows '1'. No coming-soon gate encountered.
rca of the issue: Original bug: Header.jsx had local useState isCartOpen and passed it as props to <CartDrawer isCartOpen setIsCartOpen />, but CartDrawer reads state exclusively from CartContext (useCart) and ignores props, so clicking the header cart button toggled dead local state while the drawer's Sheet stayed closed. Fix (verified): Header consumes setIsCartOpen from useCart() and renders <CartDrawer /> with no props, so both button and drawer share the same context state.
